title: Sender lists
subtitle: Checked before any rule. Allowed senders are left alone. Blocked senders go straight to the block destination.
blockDestinationLabel: Mail from blocked senders goes to
needsRulesWrite: You need rules:write to change the lists.
subdomainHelp: A domain also covers its subdomains: shop.com matches news@mail.shop.com. When two entries match, the more specific one wins.
enterPatternFirst: Enter an address or a domain first.
blockedDescription: Their mail goes to the block destination. No rule runs.
allowedDescription: Their mail is left exactly where it is: no rule, no action, no Human Review.
removeConfirmTitle: Remove this sender from the list?
removeConfirmDescription: New mail from {pattern} will be handled by your rules again. Emails already processed stay as they are.
suggestionsDescription: Senders you keep resolving the same way. Add them to a list so their emails stop landing here.
suggestionsEmpty: Nothing to suggest yet. A sender shows up here after at least 5 of its emails were resolved in the last 30 days, 90% of them the same way.
suggestionStatsSpam: {agreeing} of {total} emails marked spam in the last 30 days
suggestionStatsApproved: {agreeing} of {total} emails marked approved in the last 30 days
dismissedNote: A dismissed suggestion won't come back for 90 days.
ruleSuggestionsDescription: Built from Human Review decisions grouped by sender and a word in the subject. Narrower than allowing or blocking a whole sender: one sender can send both security notices and noise.
ruleSuggestionsEmpty: Nothing to suggest yet. A rule shows up here once people decided at least 3 emails from one sender with a shared subject word the same way.
ruleSuggestionChooseDestination: Choose where these emails should go…
ruleSuggestionAffects: Affects {count} emails in the last 30 days
ruleSuggestionAffects_one: Affects {count} email in the last 30 days
ruleSuggestionAffects_other: Affects {count} emails in the last 30 days
ruleSuggestionImpactIntro: This rule would move emails that may matter. Check what would change before creating it.
ruleSuggestionCreated: Rule created: <link>{name}</link>. If the suggestion was wrong, you can delete it like any other rule.
